operating_notes.text: Company recognized ₹0.70 Cr provision for past service costs under new Labour Codes in Q4FY26.
Mauritius subsidiary is declared defunct; full provision for investment made in earlier years.
Installed a new tubing machine at Moti-Bhoyan plant with commercial production effective 3 June 2026.
Existing tube capacity stands at 7.25 crore tubes per month at 90% utilisation; addition is 45 lakh tubes per month.
Preference share redemption schedule extended by 5 years to end of 8th, 9th, and 10th year due to absence of distributable profits.
